summary.overview: Follow-up with Acme Corp on lead routing. Priya Patel is sponsoring the project internally, budget is approved, and routing must be live before the new SDR cohort starts in April.
summary.action_items: Alex Rivera to send the security questionnaire and set up a pilot kickoff.

sentences.text: Picking up from last week. Where do things stand internally?
The core problem is still the manual handoff between marketing and sales. Leads sit untouched for days and that bottleneck is costing pipeline.
Leadership wants speed-to-lead under 5 minutes and a 30% increase in meeting conversion this year.
Who is driving this on the Acme side?
I will champion this internally and I already walked the COO through the business case.
The COO approves the final budget and signs off on vendors in this category.
She is the decision-maker for anything that touches the revenue stack.
There is $45,000 budgeted for this in the current fiscal year.
Must-haves are bi-directional HubSpot sync, round-robin routing, and audit logs.
How does the approval path work?
Security review first, then procurement issues the PO. Legal review usually takes two weeks.
The team needs routing live by the end of March because the new SDR cohort starts in April.
Next step: I will send the security questionnaire and set up a pilot kickoff.
